catalysts.headline: Lung Cancer Initiative of North Carolina participation
Company to participate in Lung Cancer Initiative of North Carolina's 'Battle of the Blues' event.
8-K discloses bioAffinity will sponsor a Learning Theater at CHEST 2026 (American College of Chest Physicians annual meeting) on the clinical use of CyPath Lung for lung cancer risk assessment
catalysts.impact: Resolves the prior pass's note about an undated CHEST 2026 sponsorship

catalysts.headline: 8-K: company to present data at CHEST 2026 on investigational sputum-based tests (explicitly not yet FDA cleared/approved).

Announced new data to be presented at CHEST 2026 on a sputum-based diagnostic test in development to characterize lung inflammation and identify biologic drug targets for asthma/COPD therapies; Gordon Downie, MD, PhD to lead a related discussion
catalysts.impact: Pipeline/platform expansion beyond CyPath Lung; no stated price reaction

catalysts.headline: Closed a ~$4 million registered direct offering (common stock at $6.122/share or pre-funded warrants at $6.115) and concurrent private placement of warrants for up to 980,072 shares at $6.122/share (exercisable after stockholder approval, 5-year term); WallachBeth Capital sole placement agent; priced 2026-10-08
catalysts.impact: Dilutive financing; distinct from and larger than the on-file $3.2M June 2026 offering

catalysts.headline: 8-K: Japan Patent Office issued a Notice of Allowance for a method-of-predicting-lung-cancer-likelihood patent covering CyPath Lung.

8-K: entered a securities purchase agreement to sell 116,545 shares of common stock plus pre-funded warrants for up to 536,836 additional shares to an institutional investor; closing occurred 2026-10-09. This dilutive financing is the most plausible driver of the recent ~-16% session move, though the exact date/size of that move could not be independently pinned down this session.

8-K discloses bioAffinity's patent portfolio now includes 22 awarded U.S. and foreign patents and 36 pending applications, including a Japanese patent allowance (the 5th patent protecting CyPath Lung in Asia, alongside China and Hong Kong)
catalysts.impact: Expands IP protection for CyPath Lung in Asian markets

catalysts.headline: 8-K discloses bioAffinity's patent portfolio now includes 22 awarded U.S. and foreign patents and 36 pending applications, including a Japanese patent allowance (the 5th patent protecting its early lung cancer test awarded in Asia, alongside China and Hong Kong)
catalysts.impact: Expands IP protection for CyPath Lung in Asian markets

catalysts.headline: 8-K/press release: CyPath Lung test sales increased more than 100% year-over-year through Q3 2026.
CyPath Lung test sales up more than 100% through Q3 2026 YTD vs. the same period in 2025; number of ordering physicians up 89% YoY in Q3 2026
catalysts.impact: Commercial-momentum update, no stated price reaction

catalysts.headline: Presented clinical and veteran-focused data on CyPath Lung at the NAVREF 2026 Annual Conference
catalysts.source: MarketScreener news listing (title only; original release not independently fetched)

catalysts.headline: Hong Kong grants Patent No. HK40048460 covering CyPath Lung technology
catalysts.impact: Bolsters Asian IP position for the diagnostic

catalysts.headline: Announced grant of Hong Kong Patent (HK40048460) for the CyPath Lung noninvasive lung-cancer diagnostic
catalysts.impact: stock up about 33% on the news, layered on top of a Sept 9 Nasdaq listing-compliance restoration and an Aug 18 nationwide federal (VA) distribution deal with AvMEDICAL

catalysts.headline: bioAffinity regains Nasdaq listing compliance for its common stock and warrants

1-for-15 reverse stock split became effective at 4:01pm ET 2026-08-21 (trading split-adjusted from the open on 2026-08-24); new CUSIP 09076W406; approximately 592,373 shares expected outstanding immediately after; approved by stockholders at the 2026-04-30 annual meeting; intended to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid-price compliance
catalysts.impact: Mechanical, not fundamental, but materially changes the share-count/price basis -- this split was NOT previously captured in the file's catalyst list

catalysts.headline: bioAffinity strikes a federal distribution deal for the CyPath Lung test
catalysts.impact: Expands distribution channel (e.g., VA hospital system)

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: EPS topped estimate
Q2 2026 results: CyPath Lung test volume up 216% YoY vs. Q2 2025; longitudinal clinical trial began patient enrollment at 11 clinical sites

bioAffinity reports Q2 2026 results: net revenue $1,510,579 (+19% YoY); CyPath Lung test volume +216% YoY; H1 2026 revenue $2,862,106 (-8.4% YoY); longitudinal CyPath Lung clinical trial begins patient enrollment at 11 sites (9 VA)
catalysts.impact: Strong CyPath Lung-specific growth, though total company revenue (including other lines) declined for the six-month period

catalysts.headline: $3.2M public offering priced (closed 2026-06-18)
